summary: Quantumsphere Acquisition Corp (QUMS), a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq blank-check company, filed an 8-K on October 9, 2026 disclosing an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Fortune Favor Technology Inc. The transaction is a SPAC business combination structured as a reverse merger. QUMS merges into its wholly owned subsidiary Fortune Favor Global Group Inc., then a second merger sub merges into Fortune Favor Technology, which survives as a wholly owned subsidiary. QUMS ordinary shares convert one-for-one into Purchaser Ordinary Shares; rights convert at one-seventh per share. No pricing, stake percentage, premium, or advisor was disclosed in the excerpt.
